message.content: In one of the conversations, LiHua shares a memorable moment from the game "Black Myth: Wukong". Specifically, he mentions, "I really enjoyed the exploration aspect too! Each area feels so unique and detailed. Plus, the lore behind the characters is fascinating. Did you find any hidden secrets while playing?" LiHua elaborates further by saying, "I really like that balance. It's refreshing to switch between action and thinking. Makes every session feel different." However, the most vivid and shared memorable moment LiHua refers to is a battle scene where he had to outsmart a giant enemy, noting that the strategy involved was so satisfying, and the graphics made it even more epic.
